description: Velocity proxy egg cho STA Cloud. Ho tro Java 8, 11, 17, 21 va 25; mac dinh chay Java 21.
startup: if [ -n "${CUSTOM_STARTUP}" ]; then eval "${CUSTOM_STARTUP}"; else java -Xms128M -Xmx{{SERVER_MEMORY}}M -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=4M -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:MaxInlineLevel=15 -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}}; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# STA Cloud Velocity installation script
# Server files: /mnt/server
PROJECT=velocity

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl jq
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

if [[ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]]; then
    echo -e "Using supplied download URL: ${DL_PATH}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(eval echo "$(echo "${DL_PATH}" | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')")
else
    PROJECT_JSON=$(curl -fsSL "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}")

    if [[ -z "${VELOCITY_VERSION}" ]] || [[ "${VELOCITY_VERSION}" == "latest" ]]; then
        VELOCITY_VERSION=$(echo "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r '.versions | to_entries | .[0].value[0]')
    else
        VER_EXISTS=$(echo "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r --arg VERSION "${VELOCITY_VERSION}" '.versions | any(.[]; index($VERSION))')
        if [[ "${VER_EXISTS}" != "true" ]]; then
            echo -e "Specified Velocity version not found. Defaulting to latest."
            VELOCITY_VERSION=$(echo "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r '.versions | to_entries | .[0].value[0]')
        fi
    fi

    BUILDS_JSON=$(curl -fsSL "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${VELOCITY_VERSION}")

    if [[ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ]] || [[ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" == "latest" ]]; then
        BUILD_NUMBER=$(echo "${BUILDS_JSON}" | jq -r '.builds[0]')
    else
        BUILD_EXISTS=$(echo "${BUILDS_JSON}" | jq -r --arg BUILD "${BUILD_NUMBER}" '.builds[] | tostring | select(. == $BUILD)' | head -n 1)
        if [[ -z "${BUILD_EXISTS}" ]]; then
            echo -e "Specified Velocity build not found. Defaulting to latest build for ${VELOCITY_VERSION}."
            BUILD_NUMBER=$(echo "${BUILDS_JSON}" | jq -r '.builds[0]')
        fi
    fi

    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -fsSL "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${VELOCITY_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}" | jq -r '.downloads."server:default".url')
fi

cd /mnt/server

echo -e "Velocity version: ${VELOCITY_VERSION:-custom}"
echo -e "Velocity build: ${BUILD_NUMBER:-custom}"
echo -e "Downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [[ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]]; then
    mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old"
fi

curl -fL -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [[ ! -f velocity.toml ]]; then
    echo -e "Downloading default Velocity configuration."
    curl -fL -o velocity.toml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PaperMC/Velocity/dev/3.0.0/proxy/src/main/resources/default-velocity.toml
fi

if [[ ! -f forwarding.secret ]]; then
    echo -e "Creating forwarding secret."
    date +%s | sha256sum | base64 | head -c 12 > forwarding.secret
fi

echo -e "STA Cloud Velocity installation complete."

variables.name: Custom Startup Command
variables.description: Optional command to run instead of the default Velocity startup command. Leave empty to use the default command.

variables.name: Velocity Version
variables.description: Velocity version to download. Use latest to install the newest stable build.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: Jar file name used to start Velocity.

variables.name: Download Path
variables.description: Direct jar URL. Hidden by default; leave empty to download from PaperMC.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: Velocity build number. Use latest to install the newest build for the selected version.
